memory_caveat.bound: 32*N + sum(lowercase-key UTF-8 bytes); allocator bookkeeping/rounding and unchanged input references/output excluded
memory_caveat.qualification: derived structural requested-storage bound, not measured whole-function peak or net peak delta

limitations: Local microbenchmark only; no whole-CLI or native runtime claim.
The superseded first timing run included SymbolTable construction and is retained as timing-end-to-end-original.txt but excluded from comparison.
All/Public allocation totals include output formatting; the paired delta is whole-function evidence.
Both VM and harness use opt-level=1; this measures the retained development/test profile and makes no release-build timing claim.

Timing used a fixed baseline-then-candidate order rather than a counterbalanced order, so ordering bias is possible; the large allocation reduction and separated timing ranges are the retention evidence.
